name: Glass Shatter
description: Voronoi facets with stress birefringence: residual stress concentrates at the facet boundaries and under load, and the resulting retardation produces per-wavelength polariscope fringes along the cracks. A press or click fragments the glass into finer shards at the impact, with fracture hairlines on the real shard borders and a faint display-space ghost of the previous frame; ACES output.

params.name: Shard Scale
params.description: Voronoi cell frequency — how many shards across the frame.

params.name: Displacement
params.description: How far shards are pushed away from the pointer.

params.name: Edge Sharpness
params.description: Bevel highlight strength and glass density; also the width and brightness of the fracture hairlines and the strength of the stress fringes.

params.name: Aberration
params.description: Chromatic split across each shard tilt.
